title: Base Modules and Signatures
summary: This module defines the foundational classes for DSPy programs, including the base module structure and mechanisms for defining and managing input/output signatures for language model interactions.

nodes.label: Manage DSPy Module State
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.base_module.BaseModule
nodes.description: Provides foundational functionalities for DSPy modules, including parameter management, deep copying, and state serialization/deserialization. It allows introspection of sub-modules and parameters.

nodes.label: Define DSPy Program Logic
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.module.Module
nodes.description: Extends BaseModule to define the structure for DSPy programs. It includes methods for defining forward logic, interacting with language models, handling callbacks, and batch processing examples.

nodes.label: Define & Validate DSPy Signatures
nodes.title: dspy.signatures.signature.SignatureMeta
nodes.description: A metaclass responsible for dynamically creating DSPy Signature classes. It handles field validation, infers instructions, and manages input/output field definitions for language model prompts.

nodes.label: Define Signature Input Field
nodes.title: dspy.signatures.field.OldInputField
nodes.description: Defines an input field within a DSPy signature, specifying its prefix, description, and format. Used to structure the input parameters for language model calls.

nodes.label: Define Signature Output Field
nodes.title: dspy.signatures.field.OldOutputField
nodes.description: Defines an output field within a DSPy signature, specifying its prefix, description, and format. Used to structure the expected output parameters from language model calls.

nodes.label: Convert Field to Old Format
nodes.title: dspy.signatures.field.new_to_old_field
nodes.description: A utility function that converts a new-style field definition into an instance of either OldInputField or OldOutputField based on its type.

nodes.label: Execute Language Model Prediction
nodes.title: dspy.Predict
nodes.description: A core DSPy component used within Modules to make predictions using a language model based on a defined signature.

nodes.label: Manage Trainable Parameters
nodes.title: dspy.Parameter
nodes.description: Represents a trainable parameter within a DSPy module, managed by BaseModule for optimization and state handling.

nodes.label: Encapsulate LM Prediction Output
nodes.title: dspy.Prediction
nodes.description: The object returned by DSPy predictors, encapsulating the language model's output and potentially usage statistics.

nodes.label: Manage Global DSPy Settings
nodes.title: dspy.settings
nodes.description: Provides access to global DSPy configuration and thread-local overrides, used for tracking usage and managing caller modules.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Parallel Program Execution
nodes.title: dspy.Parallel
nodes.description: A utility for processing lists of examples in parallel, used by Module for efficient batch execution of programs.

nodes.label: Provide Base for Data Models
nodes.title: Pydantic.BaseModel
nodes.description: A foundational class from Pydantic for creating data models, used by SignatureMeta to build robust and validated signature structures.

nodes.label: Describe Pydantic Field Properties
nodes.title: Pydantic.FieldInfo
nodes.description: Pydantic's internal representation of a field, used by SignatureMeta to manage and validate the properties of input and output fields.

groups.label: Surface Components
groups.title: Surface Components
groups.description: Components that users directly interact with to define and run DSPy programs.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Analytical Components
groups.description: Components primarily involved in introspection, state management, and optimization of DSPy modules.

groups.label: Data Definition Components
groups.title: Data Definition Components
groups.description: Components responsible for defining, validating, and transforming data structures used in DSPy, especially for LM signatures.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Generative Components
groups.description: Components that facilitate the generation of text or other outputs using language models.
